description: This file defines a message queue system with various message types, including handling of message processing, thread safety, and event loop invocation. It includes classes for messages, a message queue, and specific message types for setting position and duration, with thread synchronization and external library (GStreamer) integration.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: Abstract base class for messages with a handle method.

classes.name: CallInEventLoopMessage
classes.description: A message that executes a function in the event loop and signals completion.

classes.name: MessageQueue
classes.description: Manages a thread-safe queue of messages, with start/stop control and message processing.

classes.name: SetPositionMessage
classes.description: A message to set a new position value.

classes.name: SetDurationMessage
classes.description: A message to set a new duration value.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the message processing thread and clears the queue.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all messages from the queue.

methods.name: waitForMessage
methods.description: Blocks until a message is available in the queue and returns it.

methods.name: postMessage
methods.description: Posts a message to the queue if the queue is running.

methods.name: processMessages
methods.description: Continuously processes messages from the queue.

methods.name: callInEventLoopImpl
methods.description: Executes a function in the event loop thread, posting a message if called from another thread.

methods.name: callInEventLoop
methods.description: Template method to invoke a function in the event loop thread.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Pure virtual method to handle a message.
